newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end slightly up on settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end slightly up on settlement day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended slightly up on Monday on short-covering in oversold blue chips on settlement day, but brokers said sentiment remained depressed and activity dull as major investors stayed out.
The Karachi 100-share index rose 2.28 points, or 0.16 percent, to end at 1,419.95. Losers led gainers 206 to 89.
"It was a listless, stagnant market," dealer Shakil Anwar said. "Until the fundamentals change, there's no chance of the market shaking off its present gloom," dealer Ali Asghar said.
Hub Power rose 0.40 rupees to 30.20 and Pak State Oil 4.0 to 336. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
